summary: Frontend-only targeted retest after iteration_60 at desktop 1920x1080. Created an ephemeral Firebase user with 7 TEST_Iter60 documenti (avvolgibile molle, avvolgibile tubolare, sezionale, tapparella, scorrevole, Solo CE, Registro). Downloaded 26 PDFs via the UI: full PDF and fascicolo for each of the 5 pratiche; single ce, registro_righe and dm37; Solo CE; and StampaVuoto blank full and fascicolo for avvolgibile, tapparella and sezionale under both regimes (2026 and 2027). Checked them with PyMuPDF and visually. ALL 4 FIXES PASS. (1) The fascicolo is 4 pages in all 11 variants. A.3 ends on page 2 with 'Kit batterie tampone' and there is no '(segue)' page with 1 row. Section 5 row 1 has the right Applicazione text: 'Dal 20/01/2027: Reg. (UE) 2023/1230' for the 2006/42/CE regime and 'Sostituisce la Direttiva 2006/42/CE' for the 2027 regime. (2) CE page 2: there are 7 avvertenze, the widest ends at x=467 (≤544), and the last one ends at y=335, above the signature label at y=336, so there is no overlap. This holds in the pratica CE, Solo CE, the full PDF and the blank 2027 PDF. (3) Registro a righe: 'Tipo' is a whole word on one line in a 34pt column with no 'Tip'/'o' split, and the columns are readable. (4) DM37 Allegati obbligatori headers read 'Allegato' | 'Presente'. (5) The full PDF is now 18 pages (was 19). The global footer 'Pagina X di 18' appears once per page and runs 1..18 correctly in all 11 full PDFs, and single-document PDFs number correctly. No overlaps. 0 console errors and 0 pageerrors.

issues: Avvertenza 7 ends at y≈335 and the 'Firma e timbro per accettazione' label starts at y≈336. They do not overlap, but the gap is only about 1pt and looks cramped. Optional: move the sigBox y from 352 to about 362.
'Firma tecnico' wraps onto 2 lines while 'Firma cliente' stays on 1. This is cosmetic only.
The '(segue)' page holds only sections 8–10 (7 lines, last y≈157). This is a legitimate continuation, not a new page, and the page count is unchanged. Informational only.

action_items: None blocking. Optional cosmetic: add a few pt of space between CE avvertenza 7 and the signature labels.
critical_code_review_comments: documentiPdf.js drawCe still writes CE_AVVERTENZE at fixed y (251 + i*13.5) with no wrapping. The current texts fit, but any longer text will overflow again. splitTextToSize with an accumulated y would be more robust.
The fascicolo still fits with little slack on page 2. Any further row added to section 5 or A.3 will spill again.
